http-request.regex:
^(GET|POST|HEAD) /[a-zA-Z0-9/._?=&%-]* HTTP/1\.1
Host: [a-z0-9.-]+
User-Agent: Mozilla/5\.0 \([a-zA-Z0-9;: .()/_-]+\)
Accept: [a-zA-Z0-9/*,;= .+-]+
Accept-Language: [a-z,;=0-9. -]+

$
http-request.hybrid_regex:
^POST /[a-zA-Z0-9/._?=&%-]* HTTP/1\.1
Host: [a-z0-9.-]+
User-Agent: Mozilla/5\.0 \([a-zA-Z0-9;: .()/_-]+\)
Accept: [a-zA-Z0-9/*,;= .+-]+
Accept-Language: [a-z,;=0-9. -]+
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

$
http-request.description: HTTP request headers; format-mode records are 200-700 bytes. Hybrid uses a 200-byte POST header and a chunked encrypted body.

http-response.regex:
^HTTP/1\.1 (200 OK|302 Found|304 Not Modified|404 Not Found)
Server: [a-zA-Z0-9/. ()_-]+
Content-Type: [a-zA-Z0-9/;=. +-]+
Content-Length: 0
ETag: "[a-zA-Z0-9]+"
Set-Cookie: [a-zA-Z0-9]+=[a-zA-Z0-9%_-]+; Path=/

$
http-response.hybrid_regex:
^HTTP/1\.1 (200 OK|302 Found|404 Not Found)
Server: [a-zA-Z0-9/. ()_-]+
Content-Type: [a-zA-Z0-9/;=. +-]+
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
ETag: "[a-zA-Z0-9]+"
Set-Cookie: [a-zA-Z0-9]+=[a-zA-Z0-9%_-]+; Path=/

$
http-response.description: HTTP response headers with an empty body in format mode (200-700 bytes). Hybrid uses a 200-byte header and a chunked encrypted body.
